title: The inside scoop.
text: Sophia was amazing. Patiently and willingly shared any details we asked about. Not just about what we saw (amazing by the way) but also about her personal life and the general lives of everyday Spaniards from this area of the world. Very engaged and engaging human being who we would be delighted to remain friends with.
author: Voyage02955288113

title: SOFIA VENTURA'S MAGICAL LONG WEEKEND IN SEVILLE
text:
Seville is a very special city and to see it properly you need someone who is equally special. That person is Sofia Ventura. Her enthusiasm love and knowledge of the city is infectious, and you will enjoy an exciting voyage full of fun and adventure with little antidotes that will ensure your stay in Seville a memorable occasion that you will never forget.
Recommend you:
Firstly, contact her before arriving as she will organise your programme and avoid dubious operators who cleverly entice you on the internet to various unnecessarily overpriced tours.

title: Sofia was fantastic!
text: Sofia was fantastic! She was helpful, friendly, and very knowledgeable. We saw so many wonderful sights with her while she answered all our questions. She also gave us local tips and recommendations. I highly recommend her!!

title: Delicious tour
text:
Seville is wonderful, lots of history 
Sofia, very good, felt exactly what we wanted and we did a street tour visiting all the main points and very explanatory, sweet, welcoming. She also helped us with good store tips, took us to them, in short our experience with her was great
author: Silmara R

title: Great experience
text:
We had 2 tours with Sofia and we liked them both a lot! We got to know the city, its history and local culture. Sofia was great at telling interesting facts and stories! We appreciated her recomendations for places to eat!  

We higly recommend taking Sofia’s tours to get to know the city
author: Soleacqua

title: Sofia of Seville Tour Guide
text:
We had 2 great tours with Sofia and absolutely recommend her as a guide. She was knowledgeable, friendly, on time and picked us up from our hotel which was handy because we had just arrived and didn't know the area.
Sofia's prices were very reasonable and she was flexible to our wishes. 
Thank you again Sofia!
author: ChrisAnnieMelb

title: An Excellent Immersion in Old Sevilla
text:
With family from the US visiting we wanted them to see the best of the city, and Sofia more than obliged. We met at our hotel, and talked for a few minutes about our interests. As we strolled the narrow streets she told us the history of what we were seeing, illustrated by photos on her IPad dating from 100 years back. Ducking into a construction site we found ourselves at the Monasterio de Santa Ines, where the nuns make pastries and sell them through a lazy susan-type door, never exposing themselves to view. 
Sofia speaks very good English, and was delighted to help our 12 year old granddaug
author: Nicholas H

title: Personalized tour!!!
text:
Wow! We wanted to see “secret gems” of Seville and Sofia didn’t disappoint. She took us to parts of Seville most tourists would miss - from a neighborhood flea market, to convent to get pastry but only if you could complete the prayer of the nun on the other side of a secret revolving door, small churches with rich history, to the oldest bakery in Seville, and even to the Palace and Cathedral. 
Would highly recommend hiring Sofia and just tell her your interests and she’ll cater the tour to you.
author: Daniel O
